findings.title: The `cancel` bullet is stranded after a prose paragraph
findings.why: The README lists `addEquipment`, `quote`, `book` and `availability` as a bullet list. It then runs the pricing and period rules as a long paragraph, and `cancel` appears as a lone bullet after that paragraph, so it reads as detached from the API list. The line that opens that paragraph is also very long. Moving the `cancel` bullet up into the API list would fix both.
